description.tropimon_damage_calc.terrain:
Electric Terrain
- Grounded Electric-type attacks x1.3
- Rising Voltage x2 against a grounded target
- Terrain Pulse becomes Electric and doubles in power
- Grounded Pokémon cannot fall asleep

Grassy Terrain
- Grounded Grass-type attacks x1.3
- Earthquake, Bulldoze and Magnitude x0.5 against a grounded target
- Terrain Pulse becomes Grass and doubles in power
- Grass Pelt boosts Defense

Misty Terrain
- Dragon damage received by grounded Pokémon x0.5
- Misty Explosion x1.5
- Terrain Pulse becomes Fairy and doubles in power
- Grounded Pokémon avoid status conditions

Psychic Terrain
- Grounded Psychic-type attacks x1.3
- Expanding Force x1.5 while the user is grounded
- Terrain Pulse becomes Psychic and doubles in power
- Grounded Pokémon are protected from priority moves
description.tropimon_damage_calc.weather: Sun: boosts Fire, weakens Water and activates related abilities

Sandstorm: activates related abilities and boosts Rock-type Special Defense
Snow: activates related abilities and boosts Ice-type Defense
